name: sfcc-seller-central
description: SFCC/SFRA cartridges for a seller marketplace: seller onboarding with e-mail codes and document review, offers with a buy box on the product page, "Sold by" in cart and checkout, seller orders, commission and settlements, and a Business Manager marketplace desk - with tests and illustrated docs.
author: Vedesh Reddy

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:isml && npm run lint:docs
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
